correctness.rationale: Map composition is the multiplicative congruence monoid H10 (using the cited polygonal-map isomorphism). Modulo 10, the 3,7,9 residue weights 1,-1,2 in C4 have exactly six minimal zero-sum atom vectors A=(4,0,0),B=(0,4,0),C=(1,1,0),D=(0,0,2),E=(2,0,1),F=(0,2,1). Every irreducible length ℓ obeys 4ℓ=a+b+2c+2w; the C-count w has fixed parity, so distinct lengths require a ≥2 increment in w. Comparing the no-C factorization after removing common C atoms, four exhaustive u/v cases force the four threshold vectors (2,2,2),(2,4,1),(4,2,1),(4,4,0); explicit two-vs-three or two-vs-four atom partitions prove sufficiency. Least residues have primes 3,7,19, giving smallest 75411 and length set {2,3}. Independent recursive exact enumeration verified 185 admissible small exponent triples and witness arithmetic. The proof is uniform in all positive x.
